createdBy: code review R7 (self-review; agent reviewers hit a session limit)
impact: Real as filed but already fixed: src/pysort.ts (commit be56785) supplies code-point ordering and every min/max/sort site in the port — aggregate.ts:118-119 and all eleven renderer sort sites — routes through it, verified by passing CPython differential tests. Residual exposure is nil on parity paths; the only bare .sort() left is over ASCII package names in a resolver error message. Pre-fix impact was silently reordered success-path table rows, but only for the exotic pairing of an astral string against a BMP string above U+D800 (or an astral date), never for ordinary ASCII/BMP data.
resolution: Fixed in commit be56785 (T-004): src/pysort.ts supplies code-point ordering (pyCompareStr/pySorted/pyMinStr/pyMaxStr with CPython tie behavior); aggregate.ts:118-119 and all eleven renderer sort sites route through it. The only bare .sort() left in src/ is over ASCII package names inside a resolver error message (diagnostic path). Pinned by tests-ts/unicode-parity.test.mjs:135-150 against a CPython oracle; verified passing at triage 2026-07-31. Severity recorded as medium (down from high): the trigger required an astral-vs-BMP-above-U+D800 string comparison at a sort key — exotic — and numeric-key sorts never compare strings.
title: String ordering diverges from Python above U+FFFF (JS compares UTF-16 units, Python code points)
